listing.name: Dragon Age: Origins — Dragon-Age-Origins-Recomp (96dot)
listing.summary: Experimental Dragon Age: Origins project built locally from your Xbox 360 ISO. Upstream describes renderer, input and DLC features. Linux requires Wine or Proton and is untested upstream. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Xbox 360 Dragon Age: Origins disc with title ID 454108C0, media ID 186A1115 and English/Italian/Spanish content, or matching Ultimate Edition disc 1. Supply your own TU6/TU7 and DLC separately if using them.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow upstream setup with your own ISO. DAORecomp.exe downloads tools, translates the game and builds it locally; upstream estimates 30–60 minutes. The source setup uses install.py. Portcove does not install or build this project automatically.

warnings: Upstream describes renderer, input and DLC features, with experimental upscaling and frame-rate options. Full-game and hardware compatibility have not been confirmed by Portcove. Linux setup requires Wine or Proton, and upstream calls Linux support untested; it does not produce a native Linux game.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
